The dispute

Rider's account, as filed

Punggol to Raffles Place is 15.8 km. The app charged me for 20.2 km because the driver went off to Hougang in the middle of my trip for no reason. I know it is a pool booking but I did not agree to a 28% longer route. $26.83 for a pool trip is more than I would have paid for a normal one.

The driver's account

It is a pool booking. The system matched a second passenger at Hougang and routed me there, I just drove what the app showed me. I cannot refuse a match.

Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties: the fare of SGD 26.83 stands. No deviation is established, so nothing is refunded and nothing is paid to the driver.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate5 claim(s), 5 kept

  1. The rider's 28% figure is measured against the wrong comparator, and on this record I concede that it cannot stand.

    Read the whole claim

    trip_record.solo_optimal_distance_km of 15.80 km is the unmatched single-rider route; because trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, POL-RD-12 fixes the POL-RD-01 baseline at the matched-itinerary optimal of 19.40 km recorded in trip_record.optimal_distance_km, and the platform put that pooled route to the rider before departure ('Co-rider matched... Estimated 19.4 km, 34 min', delivered 18:42:04 and read 18:42:31, trip started 18:47:10). The Hougang mileage the rider objects to is real - the trace shows the loop - but it is distance attributable to collecting a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary, which POL-RD-12 excludes from excess before POL-RD-01 is applied, and POL-RD-12 states that a claim measured against solo_optimal_distance_km fails on that ground alone.

    EV-TRIP-00113, EV-CHAT-00113 · POL-RD-12, POL-RD-01

  2. Even on the governing baseline the arithmetic does not reach the gate, and I concede that too.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 20.18 km and governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km; against the matched-itinerary optimal of 19.40 km that is an excess of 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed 0.80 km in absolute terms AND 20% of optimal, and both tests must pass: 0.78 km falls 0.02 km short of the absolute floor. No deviation is established, POL-RD-02's recomputation never runs, and the charged total of SGD 26.83 stands; the contested SGD 6.00 is not recoverable on this record.

    EV-GPS-00113, EV-TRIP-00113 · POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02

  3. No external-cause adjustment can enlarge that baseline, which keeps the excess at the full measured figure rather than some reduced one.

    Read the whole claim

    The bundle's only traffic advisory is EV-ADVIS-00113-01 and it is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I disclose that impairment expressly, and under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact carries no fact even though its absence is itself citable. No advisory covers the Punggol-Hougang-CTE corridor in the 18:41-19:23 window, so POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied on this record and no closure-adjusted optimal exists to substitute for the booked 19.40 km; under POL-RD-13 an external traffic assertion that is not tied to an advisory carries no weight.

    EV-ADVIS-00113-01 · POL-RD-03, POL-RD-13, POL-GEN-02

  4. The rider's claim is not one the policy singles out for stronger proof, so it should not be scrutinised as though it were.

    Read the whole claim

    rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the trigger of 4 in POL-RD-08, and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0; the additional-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 therefore does not apply to this rider and the claim falls to be decided on the trace rather than on the rider's claim history. Those two fields are the only profile values I ask the tribunal to use, and POL-GEN-01 confines them to exactly this test.

    EV-RPROF-00113 · POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-01

  5. The measurement the rider's complaint rests on is sound, not defective.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-GPS-00113 carries 217 fixes at a 10 second interval over 100% coverage, with no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of limbs POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires and the excess is run along a continuous trace rather than interpolated across a dropout. The rider's claim therefore fails only on the size of the excess against the POL-RD-01 thresholds, and not on the quality of the evidence the rider brought.

    EV-GPS-00113 · POL-RD-07

Draft 1 - sampled
To both parties: the fare of SGD 26.83 stands. No deviation is established, so nothing is refunded and nothing is paid to the driver. Baseline. This was a RYDE_POOL booking, so POL-RD-12 fixes the route-deviation baseline at the MATCHED-ITINERARY optimal of 19.40 km recorded in trip_record.optimal_distance_km (EV-TRIP-00113) — the pooled route the platform computed at match time for Punggol → Hougang co-rider pickup → Raffles Place. The 15.80 km solo_optimal_distance_km on the same record is reference only. The rider's '15.8 km, 28% longer' comparison is measured against the wrong field and, on POL-RD-12's express terms, fails on that ground alone; the rider's advocate has conceded this, and I record the concession. Measurement. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 20.18 km (EV-GPS-00113) and governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 20.2 km. Excess = 20.18 − 19.40 = 0.78 km, or 4.02%.
